## End-to-End Fleet Management Solution

### Learn how GPS Fleet Management Software from Azuga can improve driver safety across your entire
### fleet of vehicles.

[Azuga Fleet Tracking for Safety]

### Four steps to safer fleet management

The Azuga Safe framework is a four-part improvement process that integrates safety into your daily
fleet operations while optimizing business operations, increasing driver safety, reducing costs, and
improving customer service.

[Assess with Telematics]

### 1. Evaluate and assess your Fleet.

Advanced diagnostics and reporting make it easy to assess advanced vehicle health, diagnostics, and
driver performance in real-time. Driver scoring ensures you and your drivers know how safely they
are, or are not, driving.

[Azuga's Four Steps to a Safer Fleet]

### 2. Turn insights into action.

With Azuga GPS Fleet Management insight in hand, you can address specific areas of risk, from
vehicle maintenance to individual driver coaching.

[Fleet Management Software with Fleet Tracking Insights]

### 3. Advanced Fleet insights.

Gain greater insight into your operations, from efficiency to safety using fleet telematics. See how
your fleet stacks up against industry standards and best-in-class fleets.

[Fleet Management Software with Ongoing Fleet Safety]

### 4. Remove risks and increase driver safety.

In addition to drivers, Azuga Fleet extends safety benefits to your entire staff, including
managers, safety directors, accountants, operations specialists, and partners such as insurance
carriers and lenders.

[fleet tracking icon]

#### New to fleet tracking?

Get a quick overview of GPS Fleet tracking, identify what your fleet needs most, and learn what to
look for when evaluating a vehicle tracking software solution.

[Read About Fleet Tracking][116]
[fleet tracking system ROI with time savings]

#### Fleet Tracking ROI

GPS fleet tracking provides benefits to fleets of all sizes. Tell us about your fleet and see how
Azuga Fleet can help your bottom line.

[Calculate Your Savings][117]
[scheduling icon]

#### Ready to roll?

Take the next step. Contact us to schedule a demo, request a quote, or answer any questions you may
have. Let's roll.

[Get Started][118]

## SafetyCam Pro & SafetyCam Plus

### Azuga's SafetyCam AI turns better driving into second nature. The smart way to improve driver
### behavior and safety on the road and in real time!

Be prepared for anything that comes your way with ai-based smart detection software and the accuracy
of our the dual-facing dashcams. The all new SafetyCam Pro & SafetyCam Plus capture both
front-facing road events and in-cab driver behavior, giving you a clear picture of what’s happening
on the road when it matters most. Protect your drivers, and your business, with the ability to
exonerate yourself when the driver is not at fault.

**Take Advantage of DashCam Technology**

‍][120][How AI Dashcams Can Reduce Insurance Premiums][121]

[Learn More][122]

## GPS Fleet Tracking

### GPS Fleet Tracking that is simple to use, affordable, and powerful enough to run any size fleet

From small businesses to enterprise fleets, Azuga's fleet management platform is the best solution
to:
Keep track of drivers
Improve safety
Protect all your assets
Track vehicles in real-time

**Harness the Power of Fleet Tracking**
‍[4 Ways Fleet Tracking Improves Your Fleet Safety Program
‍][123][Top 3 Benefits of GPS Fleet Tracking for Fleet Drivers
‍][124][Top 3 Benefits of GPS Fleet Tracking for Fleet Managers][125]

[Learn More][126]

[fleet mobile app with driver scores]

## Fleet Tracking App

### Run your business from anywhere with Fleet Mobile: The Top Fleet Tracking App

Included with your Azuga Fleet subscription, Fleet Mobile keeps your fleet rolling safely mile after
mile. Separate views for administrators and drivers ensures your entire team can work more
efficiently, wherever they go. With the Azuga Driver Scoring model you can quickly assess which
drivers are doing well and implement reward programs for improved driver engagement. Conversely, you
can identify your most at-risk drivers and help them improve through customized training and
gamification.

**Optimize Your Mobile App**
‍[Increase Your Efficiency with a Mobile Fleet Tracking App
‍][127][All You Need to Know About Subscription-Based Fleet Tracking Apps
‍][128][How Your Drivers Can Benefit From Using a Mobile Fleet Tracking App on Their Phones][129]

[Learn More][130]

## Driver Safety Scores

### Fleet safety and training programs for drivers including gamification and rewards

Azuga is committed to supporting a "safety first" environment for drivers. The Fleet Safety
Management Platform reduces risky driving behavior while rewarding drivers.

**Target Dangers at the Source**
‍[Limit Driver Distractions on the Road With Fleet Tracking Systems
‍][131][How Fleet Driver Scores Can Improve Safety & Productivity
‍][132][How to Implement a Solid Safety Plan with Azuga][133]

[Learn More][134]

on the road into teachable moments before an incident occurs. Smart Sequence™ surfaces the most
urgent events first, along with video and context, so managers can coach, review and take action
without chasing footage or sorting through endless alerts. Focus on what demands your attention and
change outcomes, all within Geotab's unified safety platform.

## Advanced fleet management software solutions

Track vehicles in the field, [improve fleet operations][75], increase worker productivity and [safe
driving][76] with Verizon Connect fleet management solutions. Choose from a range of customizable
GPS tracking solutions that offer [dashboards][77], [reports][78] and [alerts.][79]

## AI dashcam video solutions

**Protect your drivers and your bottom line with intelligent video analytics**

Unseen road hazards, distracted driving habits, and false insurance claims put your drivers and your
operational budget at constant risk. Standard telematics can show you where a vehicle is, but it
cannot protect you from the hidden costs and liability of a critical road incident.
* Utilize dual-facing, AI-integrated fleet dashcams for distracted driving detection that
  immediately flags phone use, tiredness, and dangerous habits right when they happen
* Reinforce long-term driver behavior improvement by giving your operators the tools to correct
  driving habits in the moment with proactive in-cab audible notifications
* Reduce costly liability from false claims by deploying Extended View Cameras that offer near
  360-degree clarity alongside forward-facing evidence to establish the facts

Telemetics for Business Fleets

## Zubie Fleet Connect

The Info You Need, The Moment You Need It

Whether you need a fuel & mileage reading, a diagnostic check, or a quick re-route of a fleet
driver, Zubie unifies telematics and GPS data in a simple, seamless platform.

[Learn More][72]Watch Video<video class="modal--video" controls autoplay><source
src="https://zubie.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/04/86305_ZUBIE_FLEET_123019_A_EV-OPI.mp4"
type=""></video>
[Highway system from an aerial view and some branded flourishes.]

## What Fleet Connect Provides

Zubie Fleet Connect integrates all the telematics tools any fleet-operating company relies on into a
single, convenient platform. Take Zubie with you and share data with anyone. Our simple-to-use fleet
telematics devices make it easy to always know where your vehicles are. Zubie redefines fleet
vehicle management. **By connecting to Fleet Connect, you’ll get:**

### [GPS Tracking][73]

Always-on GPS tracking for light and heavy duty vehicles. Real time alerts and trip history
supported by detailed maps and timelines. You can track your fleet’s every move. Manage your fleet
and plan your routes based on fleet telematics data.

[Read More][74]

### [Vehicle Health Diagnostics][75]

Detect engine and battery problems. Track maintenance. Remotely check fuel levels. Business fleet
management made simple with all your vehicle and health records in one, real-time location.

[Read More][76]

### [Smart Maintenance][77]

Big discounts for small-to-medium sized fleets: an average of 26% savings on routine services. Zubie
saves you time and money with concise fleet maintenance telematics. Never miss maintenance checks or
lose vehicles to poor health conditions. Your fleet will spend more time on the road and less time
in the shop.

[Read More][78]

### [Driver Performance Data][79]

Improve safety and efficiency, through intelligent alerts, reports and dashboards. Maintain full
transparency with your drivers via detailed reports. Keep your investments safe and your drivers
accountable for their actions.

[Read More][80]

### [Access to Integrations][81]

Integrate GPS tracking into 3rd party apps, home grown systems, or big data, [using our API][82].
Upgrading to Zubie doesn’t come at the cost of compatibility. We mesh seamlessly with most systems
so you can customize your dashboard to meet your business needs.

[Read More][83]
[Documents stacked on top of one another to show process]
[Dashcam showing 0mph and direction.]

## Fleet Connect Dashcams

Our [newest hardware device][84], Zubie Dashcam, features OBD-II and GPS connectivity in addition to
HD video recording and automatic cloud uploads. Images and clips are visible directly on Zubie’s
live map and trip history view along with vehicle telematics.

[Dashcams][85]

Telematics for Rental Fleets

## Zubie Rental Connect

Total Vehicle Management Made Easy

Rental operators love Zubie’s [one-step installation][86] and counter system integrations. Easy
access to fuel & odometer data makes check-ins and maintenance tracking a breeze. Zubie’s live map
and geofences help recover stolen assets and prevent unauthorized usage.

With Zubie’s easy-to-use interface, you get fleet management made simple. Our telematics software
puts everything you need to within reach.

[Learn More][87]Watch Video<video class="modal--video" controls autoplay><source
src="https://zubie.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/ICRS-2024-Panel-Video.mp4" type=""></video>
[Car rental fleet management]

## What Rental Connect Provides

Zubie Rental Connect provides rental companies everything they need to manage inventory more
effectively and keep cars on the road more reliably.

Our fleet management telematics solutions make tracking your rental fleet easier than ever. You’ll
never question where your vehicle is located.  Streamline your checkout and check in processes and
keep your fleet health records up to date – all in one simple to use platform.

### Vehicle Protection

Powered by Live Map GPS tracking, geofencing, tow alerts and other fraud reduction tools.

State-of-the-art fleet telematics analytics let you know where your vehicles are at any moment.
Share location data with staff to estimate vehicle returns or with law enforcement to expedite
stolen vehicle recovery.

### Vehicle Utilization Data

Through idle inventory exception reporting, offsite lot management and our real-time vehicle health
dashboard.

Fleet management features like vehicle utilization help proactively manage vehicle location and
monitor vehicle health to give you greater insight to manage your fleet more efficiently. Maximize
your fleet’s potential.

### Counter Systems Intelligence

That allows you to streamline your workflow by linking Zubie with your systems.

Integrate Zubie’s fleet tracking app with your current rental platform. Install in minutes and log
in to a single destination to manage all your company’s data.

[GPS point on a map showing location]

## Why Zubie?

Zubie’s devices deliver [fuel and odometer data][88] with extensive coverage of the most recent
makes & models. Our out-of-the-box integrations with the most widely used counter systems make it
even easier to get up and running. And many franchise operators have seen a nearly instant return on
investment just from recovering stolen vehicles. No matter your objective, Zubie can simplify your
operations and add value immediately.

## What Rental Connect Provides

Zubie Rental Connect provides rental companies everything they need to manage inventory more
effectively and keep cars on the road more reliably.

Our fleet management telematics solutions make tracking your rental fleet easier than ever. You’ll
never question where your vehicle is located.  Streamline your checkout and check in processes and
keep your fleet health records up to date – all in one simple to use platform.

### Vehicle Protection

Powered by Live Map GPS tracking, geofencing, tow alerts and other fraud reduction tools.

State-of-the-art fleet telematics analytics let you know where your vehicles are at any moment.
Share location data with staff to estimate vehicle returns or with law enforcement to expedite
stolen vehicle recovery.

### Vehicle Utilization Data

Through idle inventory exception reporting, offsite lot management and our real-time vehicle health
dashboard.

Fleet management features like vehicle utilization help proactively manage vehicle location and
monitor vehicle health to give you greater insight to manage your fleet more efficiently. Maximize
your fleet’s potential.

### Counter Systems Intelligence

That allows you to streamline your workflow by linking Zubie with your systems.

Integrate Zubie’s fleet tracking app with your current rental platform. Install in minutes and log
in to a single destination to manage all your company’s data.

## Our core business

# Your mobility. Made easy.

At Alphabet, we specialise in fleet leasing and management. Through personal consulting &
innovation, we help you optimise your fleet and accelerate business performance.

[Get to know us][40]

 

Innovation

## What differentiates us

At Alphabet, we combine innovative solutions with personal consulting to make mobility easy. Backed
by BMW expertise and offering multi-brand vehicle options, we simplify complexity and turn data into
clear decisions. Your mobility. Made easy.

 

What sets us apart: tailored leasing solutions that adapt to your specific business needs,
innovative tools and a strong commitment to sustainability, and seamless support helping you
navigate every step with confidence.
1. ### Alphabet Connected Fleet
   
   Integrated into the 360 Fleet Portal via single sign-on, it includes real-time data into
   exclusive tools such as AI-driven Fleet Reporting and sharpens your ESG reporting with the
   Alphabet Carbon Manager. The result: smarter decisions, easier consulting, and simpler fleet
   management.
   
   [ Discover Connected Fleet ][41]
2. [Person sitting at a desk in a modern office, working on a computer with the Alphabet website
   open, surrounded by green plants and large windows.]
   
   ### AI-driven Fleet Reporting
   
   The award winning Alphabet AI Assistant transforms Fleet Reporting into a smart, intuitive
   experience. Just ask a question – the system delivers clear, data-based answers in seconds,
   helping you navigate complexity and make better decisions faster.
   
   [ More on Fleet Reporting ][42]
3. [Man with gray hair and a light sweater stands outdoors and smiles.]
   
   ### Sustainability
   
   Discover how Alphabet is driving sustainability through impactful initiatives in mobility, fleet
   electrification, and responsible business practices. Learn more about our environmental, social,
   and governance efforts in the latest ESG report.
   
   [ Discover our sustainability commitments ][43]

Solutions

## How we empower your fleet success

At Alphabet, we make business mobility easy by giving you access to powerful tools and expert
consulting across key areas of fleet management.
[Man shows content on a tablet to two people in a modern office.]

## Expert consultation for your fleet

Get expert advice tailored to your fleet, business goals, and industry. We help you optimise costs,
reduce emissions, and navigate complex topics like electrification and digitalisation. Our
consultants turn mobility challenges into strategic opportunities so your business stays efficient,
sustainable, and future-ready.
[ Consulting overview ][44]
[Three women discuss in front of a green car, holding a tablet.]
Our services

## Complete operational coverage

Tax and fine management, smart fuel and charging coordination, and seamless charging infrastructure
setup. Keep your fleet moving with fast replacement vehicles, reliable roadside assistance, and
always-on online services. To round it off, we offer safety and eco-driving training to help your
team drive better, safer, and smarter.

## Our core business

# Your mobility. Made easy.

At Alphabet, we specialise in fleet leasing and management. Through personal consulting &
innovation, we help you optimise your fleet and accelerate business performance.

[Get to know us][40]

 

Innovation

## What differentiates us

At Alphabet, we combine innovative solutions with personal consulting to make mobility easy. Backed
by BMW expertise and offering multi-brand vehicle options, we simplify complexity and turn data into
clear decisions. Your mobility. Made easy.

 

What sets us apart: tailored leasing solutions that adapt to your specific business needs,
innovative tools and a strong commitment to sustainability, and seamless support helping you
navigate every step with confidence.
1. ### Alphabet Connected Fleet
   
   Integrated into the 360 Fleet Portal via single sign-on, it includes real-time data into
   exclusive tools such as AI-driven Fleet Reporting and sharpens your ESG reporting with the
   Alphabet Carbon Manager. The result: smarter decisions, easier consulting, and simpler fleet
   management.
   
   [ Discover Connected Fleet ][41]
2. [Person sitting at a desk in a modern office, working on a computer with the Alphabet website
   open, surrounded by green plants and large windows.]
   
   ### AI-driven Fleet Reporting
   
   The award winning Alphabet AI Assistant transforms Fleet Reporting into a smart, intuitive
   experience. Just ask a question – the system delivers clear, data-based answers in seconds,
   helping you navigate complexity and make better decisions faster.
   
   [ More on Fleet Reporting ][42]
3. [Man with gray hair and a light sweater stands outdoors and smiles.]
   
   ### Sustainability
   
   Discover how Alphabet is driving sustainability through impactful initiatives in mobility, fleet
   electrification, and responsible business practices. Learn more about our environmental, social,
   and governance efforts in the latest ESG report.
   
   [ Discover our sustainability commitments ][43]

Solutions

## How we empower your fleet success

At Alphabet, we make business mobility easy by giving you access to powerful tools and expert
consulting across key areas of fleet management.
[Man shows content on a tablet to two people in a modern office.]

## Expert consultation for your fleet

Get expert advice tailored to your fleet, business goals, and industry. We help you optimise costs,
reduce emissions, and navigate complex topics like electrification and digitalisation. Our
consultants turn mobility challenges into strategic opportunities so your business stays efficient,
sustainable, and future-ready.
[ Consulting overview ][44]
[Three women discuss in front of a green car, holding a tablet.]
Our services

## Complete operational coverage

Tax and fine management, smart fuel and charging coordination, and seamless charging infrastructure
setup. Keep your fleet moving with fast replacement vehicles, reliable roadside assistance, and
always-on online services. To round it off, we offer safety and eco-driving training to help your
team drive better, safer, and smarter.
[ Consulting overview ][45]

**Best for:**
Organizations already invested in ServiceNow that need 

deeper asset accuracy and auditing.

## AssetTrack for Anyone
* Works alongside your exisiting systems
* A system of record. Not spreadsheets
* Full lifecycle tracking and control

**Best for:**

## Asset Management for Everyone

## From IT to Finance to the C-suite, every team benefits from accurate, real-time asset visibility.

### IT

Reduce audit effort and eliminate manual tracking with automated, real-time asset visibility

### Procurement

Maintain accurate, audit-ready records to support smarter purchasing decisions

### Finance

Eliminate lost or “ghost” assets that drive unnecessary purchases and write-offs

### Executive

Leverage real-time dashboards and reports to maximize asset ROI and drive smarter decisions

## Asset Lifecycle Tracking

Automate asset lifecycle tracking from **purchase** to **retirement** and *everything* in between.

Easily create your own **forms**, collect **signatures**, and add **attachments**. Set rules to keep
your data clean and use smart tools to update or close records automatically.

[ Learn More ][19]

## Barcode & RFID Scanning

Scan **barcodes**, **QR codes**, and **RFID tags** using *any* device—phones, tablets, or scanners.
It works on **iOS** and **Android**, where you can collect data **online** or **offline**.

[ Learn More ][20]

## Audits for Anyone

Easily **schedule audits** for specific items, groups, or locations—and let users confirm the
equipment they use themselves.

Manage assets in your stockroom and create automatic notifications to follow up on anything
**missing**.

With **multi-user access** and smart scheduling, audits are faster, more accurate, and a lot less
work.

[ Learn More ][21]

Whether you’re overwhelmed by scattered assets or just looking for a better way to stay on top of

With clear steps and actionable advice, our 5-step guide is built for asset managers who want
structure, clarity, and control — without the guesswork. 
1. Set clear goals
2. Focus your scope
3. Choose the right metrics
4. Build your toolkit
5. Establish a repeatable process

[ Get the Guide ][22]

## Cooler Master ESG

In response to the Paris Agreement, Cooler Master has established group-level greenhouse gas (GHG)
reduction targets, decarbonization pathways, and transition strategies. Our science-based targets
were officially validated by the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi). Through continuous
decarbonization efforts, we have achieved meaningful progress: in 2024, our absolute GHG emissions
were approximately 59% lower than the 2022 base year, demonstrating steady advancement along our
science-based reduction pathway.

# Goodgame Empire

Goodgame Empire is a popular online strategy game that allows you to build your own empire, create
and manage a kingdom, and cooperate or fight with other players. The game offers a wide range of
development options, diplomatic relations and strategic decisions that will affect your success in
the game world.

## Introduction to Goodgame Empire

[Goodgame Empire][1] is a popular multiplayer strategy game that allows players to build and develop
their own empire. Players form alliances, fight enemies, and manage resources.

[Goodgame Empire]

## What is Goodgame Empire?
* An online real-time strategy game developed by Goodgame Studios.
* It allows players to build fortresses, armies, and expand their territory.
* Players can create and manage their own empire.
* The game supports multiplayer battles and alliance cooperation.
* The game is available on various platforms, including web browsers and mobile devices.

## Basic elements of Goodgame Empire
* **Fortress** - the main building that determines the development of your empire.
* **Resources** - wood, stone, food and gold are key to development and construction.
* **Army** - units of various types for defense and attack.
* **Alliance** - groups of players who cooperate and share resources.
* **Research** - technologies that improve your abilities.
* **Attacks and defense** - key aspects of the game for victory over opponents.

## Development strategy in Goodgame Empire
* Optimizing resource collection for faster development.
* Good fortress defense and strategic location buildings.
* Create strong alliances and cooperate with other players.
* Regularly level up and research new technologies.
* Use tactics to attack enemies and defend your own territory.

## Tips and tricks for Goodgame Empire players
* Start slowly and focus on collecting resources.
* Create a strong alliance and communicate with other players.
* Regularly check the status of your fortress and develop key buildings.
* Invest in research and upgrading units.
* Plan a strategy for attacks and defense, use the terrain and timing.
* Keep track of the game and follow the news from the developers.
* Don't forget about daily rewards and special events that help development.
* Create and maintain friendships with other players for greater strength.
* Avoid unnecessary attacks that could weaken your resources or units.

# A Powerful Open Source Platform to Manage your Enterprise Android Devices
* Quick and Easy to Install “Out of the Box”
* Supports Standard, Rugged, and Dedicated Devices
* Works in Isolated Air-Gapped Networks
* Ideal for OEMs and Custom ROMs
* Advanced Enterprise MDM Features

[Open Source][45]
[START FREE TRIAL][46]


## What Is MDM and How Does it Work?

*Scaling your business requires efficient device management. MDM software helps you centrally manage
your enterprise tablets, smartphones, kiosks, and digital signage devices. It’s especially useful
for managing unattended devices, eliminating hours of manual maintenance.*

• **Group-based policy management** keeps hundreds of devices configured consistently, simplifying
day-to-day operations.

• **Device status monitoring** helps you quickly identify problems and take action before they
affect your business.

• **Remote support** enables IT administrators to troubleshoot and resolve device issues without
physically accessing the device.

### 1 Create a profile


Configure the apps, settings, and policies your devices need for work

### 2 Enroll devices


Set up devices in minutes by scanning a QR code – no advanced IT skills required

### 3 Use for work


Employees receive business-ready devices that are configured and ready to use

[

## Software Teams

* Keep your apps up to date
* Collect logs remotely
* Configure apps from the console
* Use the privileged MDM API
* Leverage an open-source platform
* Build enterprise-ready AOSP devices

][47]

[Community edition
free download][48]

[

## Enterprise IT

* Monitor your device fleet
* Deploy and update apps remotely
* Apply policies to device groups
* Track device status and location
* Verify work with photo reports
* Control internet access

][49]

[Enterprise
get a free trial now!][50]

## Free Up Your Team’s Time

Headwind MDM helps your team get more done!

Each managed device can save up to 4 – 6 hours of employee time
and 1 – 2 hours of IT time every month.

100 managed devices =

up to 800 hours saved every month!
* Higher productivity
* Less downtime
* Fewer IT interruptions
* Happier employees

## Why Headwind MDM?

#### • Open Source

Headwind MDM Community is available on GitHub. Open-core Enterprise licenses are available.

#### • Standalone

The software doesn’t rely on any cloud services. It can run on your premises, even without an
Internet connection.

#### • Integrated

The mobile agent can be signed with platform keys and preinstalled in the device firmware.

#### • Secure

We use industry-standard encryption and signatures to protect your data, and perform regular
security audits.

## Enterprise License Benefits
* Restrict access to apps and settings
* Use location, photo reports, and other plugins
* Run devices in single-app kiosk mode
* Lock or wipe lost devices remotely
* Remote control with unattended access
* Filter web traffic across all apps
* Premium support and free on-premises setup
* OEM firmware integration (POS, STBs, and more)

[Get a free trial now!][51]


Any more questions? Our MDM experts are happy to help you onboarding. [Talk to an expert][52]

## ALMOST COMPLETE!

Tell us about your use case (industry, device models, MDM requirements, etc.) so we can prepare the
best demo environment for you

Discover the top coolest headquarters and corporate offices in the world—iconic workplaces known for
innovative design, creative architecture, and inspiring office environments. These world-class
company headquarters set new standards for modern corporate office culture, blending functionality
with bold aesthetics to create spaces that employees genuinely enjoy working in every day.

headquarters showcase how thoughtful design, open collaboration spaces, and employee-focused
amenities can transform the workplace experience. Each headquarters highlights unique approaches to
office layout, sustainability, wellness, and creativity, making them a powerful source of
inspiration for corporate office management teams and business leaders worldwide.

across the globe.

## **What can you find in a company headquarters?**

In a company headquarters, you will typically find the organization’s leadership team along with its
most critical business functions. These departments and offices work together to manage strategy,
operations, and long-term growth:

  strategic decision-making.
* **Executive Team & Board of Directors** – Oversees corporate governance, policy direction, and
  high-level business objectives.

  support functions.
* **Finance, Accounting & Billing Department** – Manages budgets, financial reporting, payroll,

  efforts.

  issues.
* **Research & Development Department** – Focuses on innovation, product development, and improving
  existing services or technologies.
* **Operations & Logistics** – Oversees daily business operations, supply chains, and operational
  efficiency.
* **Human Resources Department** – Manages recruitment, employee relations, benefits, training, and
  workplace policies.
* **Legal Department** – Handles contracts, regulatory compliance, risk management, and legal
  matters affecting the company.

# **Company Headquarters**

Company Headquarters is a comprehensive and authoritative directory hub dedicated to providing
accurate, up-to-date headquarters information for tens of thousands of leading companies across the
United States and around the world. Our platform is designed to serve as a trusted resource for
users who are searching for reliable corporate headquarters details in one centralized location.

We provide this headquarters information completely free of charge, making it easy to access
essential company data without subscriptions or hidden fees. Our listings include verified corporate
phone numbers, headquarters addresses, office locations, official websites, login portals, and
additional company-related information that users frequently search for online. Every detail
published on Company Headquarters is carefully reviewed to ensure clarity, accuracy, and usefulness.

Behind the scenes, our dedicated team works around the clock to collect, organize, and validate
headquarters data from multiple reliable sources. Each company profile goes through a detailed
process of sorting, data cleaning, and verification before it is published on our website. This
process ensures that outdated, incomplete, or misleading information is minimized, and that users
can rely on our directory with confidence.

Company Headquarters is committed to maintaining one of the most reliable and user-friendly
headquarters information directories available online. By continuously monitoring data updates and
verifying corporate details, we make sure the best and most accurate headquarters information is
accessible to users at all times, helping them quickly find the corporate contact and location
details they need, all in one convenient place.

Browse through our carefully selected headquarters listings to quickly locate the company
headquarters you are searching for, whether the organization operates locally, nationally, or
internationally. Our structured headquarters lists are organized for easy navigation, allowing users
to explore companies by name, category, or relevance and efficiently access accurate corporate
headquarters information in just a few clicks.

For a faster and more direct experience, you can also use the headquarters search box to search
across our complete headquarters directory. This powerful search feature enables you to instantly
find detailed company headquarters information, including corporate phone numbers, official
addresses, office locations, websites, and additional verified data, all from one centralized
platform.

## **Top Coolest Headquarters in the World**

Discover the top coolest headquarters and corporate offices in the world—iconic workplaces known for
innovative design, creative architecture, and inspiring office environments. These world-class
company headquarters set new standards for modern corporate office culture, blending functionality
with bold aesthetics to create spaces that employees genuinely enjoy working in every day.

From cutting-edge technology campuses to architecturally stunning corporate offices, these
headquarters showcase how thoughtful design, open collaboration spaces, and employee-focused
amenities can transform the workplace experience. Each headquarters highlights unique approaches to
office layout, sustainability, wellness, and creativity, making them a powerful source of
inspiration for corporate office management teams and business leaders worldwide.

To explore these incredible headquarters in action and see what makes them stand out, watch the
video below for a visual tour of some of the coolest corporate offices in the world:

If you have ever wondered what it would be like to work in a truly inspiring corporate environment,
these headquarters represent the ultimate vision of modern office life. They are not just
offices—they are destinations that reflect company culture, innovation, and forward-thinking
leadership, and they continue to influence how organizations design and manage their headquarters
across the globe.

## **What can you find in a company headquarters?**

In a company headquarters, you will typically find the organization’s leadership team along with its
most critical business functions. These departments and offices work together to manage strategy,
operations, and long-term growth:
* **Chief Executive Officer (CEO) Office** – Responsible for overall vision, leadership, and
  strategic decision-making.
* **Executive Team & Board of Directors** – Oversees corporate governance, policy direction, and
  high-level business objectives.
* **Administration Office** – Handles internal coordination, office management, and organizational
  support functions.
* **Finance, Accounting & Billing Department** – Manages budgets, financial reporting, payroll,
  billing, and compliance.
* **Marketing & Communications Department** – Develops branding, public relations, advertising, and
  internal and external communications.
* **Sales Department** – Drives revenue generation, client acquisition, and business development
  efforts.
* **Customer Service & Support** – Provides assistance to customers, manages inquiries, and resolves
  issues.
* **Research & Development Department** – Focuses on innovation, product development, and improving
  existing services or technologies.
* **Operations & Logistics** – Oversees daily business operations, supply chains, and operational
  efficiency.
* **Human Resources Department** – Manages recruitment, employee relations, benefits, training, and
  workplace policies.
* **Legal Department** – Handles contracts, regulatory compliance, risk management, and legal
  matters affecting the company.

Together, these offices form the operational and strategic core of a company, making the
headquarters the central hub for leadership, planning, and decision-making.

## **проекты**

[
Роскосмос Байконур (Казахстан)
Авиакосмическая промышленность
Изыскательские работы, проектирование, оформление разрешений на использование радиочастот, поставка
оборудования, монтаж и настройка, обучение персонала, сервисная, гарантийная и постгарантийная
поддержка.
][53] [
Лукойл. МЛСП им. Ю. Корчагина
Нефтегазовая промышленность
Специалистами компании ЛЕО ТЕЛЕКОМ была запроектирована система связи, удовлетворяющая всем
вышеуказанным требованиям. Произведена поставка оборудования, монтаж, пуско-наладочные работы и ввод
в эксплуатацию системы профессиональной цифровой транкинговой радиосвязи на базе оборудования
Kenwood Nexedge. Произведена сертификация взрывобезопасного абонентского оборудования.
Распределенная система АФУ покрывает все зоны платформы, включая внутренние, труднодоступные для
проникновения радиосигнала, помещения.
][54] [
Авианосец "Адмирал Горшков" - "Викрамадитья"
Морской флот
Система бортовой связи стандарта NXDN на базе оборудования Kenwood Nexedge была разработана и
внедрена специалистами ЗАО «ЛЕО ТЕЛЕКОМ» совместно со специалистами ОАО «Муромский радиозавод».
Установлены 8 цифровых ретрансляторов, система записи переговоров, произведена интеграция с бортовой
системой громкоговорящей связи и оповещения. Разработан абонентский комплект, состоящий из цифровой
радиостанции, спецчехла и шумозащищенной гарнитуры.
][55]

# Payments, tax & subscriptions for software companies

Selling digital downloads, subscriptions, and software licenses has never been easier, faster, or
more secure.

[
Get started
][32]

## trusted by thousands of companies globally

why lemon squeezy?

## Lemon Squeezy is the all-in-one platform for running your SaaS business. Payments, subscriptions,
## global tax compliance, fraud prevention, multi-currency support, failed payment recovery, PayPal
## integration and more. We make running your software business easy peasy.

01

### Global tax compliance

We’re your merchant of record. That means **we handle payments, merchant fees, fraud and sales tax**
without you lifting a finger.

02

### Borderless SaaS payments

Instantly sell your digital products around the globe. As your merchant of record, you can **accept
payments from 135+ countries** right out of the box with zero setup.

03

### Instant payment methods

Our no-code and API solutions **support 20+ payment methods**, and we offer bank payouts globally.

04

### Local currency support

Offer your products in your local currency to **increase checkout conversions**. Lemon Squeezy
currency support spans 130+ countries.

05

### A.I. fraud prevention

Using real-time AI to detect anomalous patterns across signups, logins, refunds, and other actions,
**Lemon Squeezy protects you from malicious attacks**.

06

### Failed payment recovery

Lemon Squeezy offers a **powerful dunning management system** to combat involuntary churn from
subscriptions, card retries, and customer emails.

ecommerce

## Create the perfect buying experience for your customers

Launch your secure ecommerce website and start selling software, subscriptions and digital downloads
anywhere in minutes. **Utilize no-code checkout links** without worrying about design, mobile
optimization, or payment integrations. It really is easy-peasy.

[
e/1

### Accept online payments

Don't worry about merchant accounts and billing logic. **Choose per seat, usage-based and more**.
Customize as little or as much as you like.

][33][
e/2

### Recurring billing + subscriptions

Charge customers on a weekly, monthly, or yearly basis. **Manage upgrades, downgrades, and
cancels**. Offer free trials, discounts, and more.

][34][
e/3

### License key management

Automatically issue license keys for your software and apps after each sale. **Deactivate, re-issue,
and have full control** over license management.

][35][
e/4

### Sell digital downloads

Anyone can provide download links, but what about security and abuse? Your **download links are
securely signed**, throttled, and more.

][36][
e/5

### No-code checkout forms

No matter what you use for your website, you can **embed your checkout** or **share your unique
checkout links** and sell anywhere.

][37][
e/6

### Launch your ecommerce store

Build an ecommerce website in minutes **without coding or design skills**. Customizable, SSL secured
and mobile-optimized as standard.

][38]
marketing

## Grow your business with integrated marketing tools

Grow your audience, build long-lasting customer relationships, and make more sales with **powerful,
easy-to-use marketing tools**. Whether you need to offer discount codes or you want to build your
email list, you can do it all with Lemon Squeezy.

[

# How do I choose the best GPS tracker for my needs?

The best GPS tracking device depends on what you're tracking and what business problems you're
trying to solve.

If you manage company vehicles, look for a solution that provides real-time GPS tracking, driver
behavior monitoring, maintenance alerts, and reporting to help improve productivity, safety, and
operating costs.

If you're tracking trailers, heavy equipment, or other valuable assets, prioritize long battery
life, durable weather-resistant hardware, and flexible installation options.

Beyond the hardware itself, evaluate the complete tracking platform. A business-grade GPS solution
should include:
* Real-time location tracking
* Mobile and desktop access
* Custom alerts and geofences
* Maintenance scheduling
* Driver safety insights
* Easy reporting
* Responsive U.S.-based customer support
* Scalable pricing that grows with your business

For many businesses, the software and support ultimately deliver more value than the tracking device
alone.

Linxup offers a range of GPS tracking devices for vehicles, trailers, and equipment, backed by an
easy-to-use fleet management platform that helps businesses reduce costs, improve visibility, and
make better operational decisions. Whether you manage five vehicles or several hundred assets,
Linxup provides solutions that scale as your business grows.

## How Does Linxup's Vehicle Tracker Work?

GPS satellites send radio signals to a connected GPS device within a vehicle or asset, allowing it
to calculate its precise location.

The GPS device within the vehicle or asset sends those location coordinates and other data like
movement and speed to a cellular tower when it's within range.

Linxup servers receive the data, analyze it, and gain insights like location history and alerts. We
send the data, including location history, alerts, and driver behavior, to our customer portal,
where you can access it.

## Efficient Retail Fulfillment Across Every Mile at Lower Costs

Our AI-powered logistics platform enables captive, contracted, outsourced, and hybrid fleets to
deliver more while optimizing resources.

Whether you're a Big & Bulky retailer, a leading CPG/FMCG manufacturer, or a multi-brand B2B/B2C
retailer, Locus has solutions tailored for you.

Click the orange icons to discover how Locus delivers results

[Watch our 90-second explainer video][85]

[hero infographics] [hero infographics]

#### Line Haul FTL/PTL

Optimize your fleet’s first-mile or linehaul routes by loading vehicles at full truckloads, or find
new cost efficiencies by hiring freight at less than full or partial truckloads.

[Know more][86] [Volume Utilization][87]

#### Store Replenishment

More and more SKUs are now competing for the same shelf space. Ensure Retail store shelves are
consistently stocked multiple times a day for optimal profitability and operating costs.

[Know more][88] [How to Cut Down on Retail Delivery Costs][89]

#### Multiple Hops Last Mile

Optimize your captive or contracted fleet’s productivity or leverage a vast network of reliable
transporters to add multiple hops within a route.

[Know more][90] [Omnichannel playbook][91]

#### Using in-house Drivers/ShipFlex

Enable robust last-mile fulfillment across captive or contracted fleets at optimal costs and
operational efficiency. Alternatively, outsource them to the right carrier at the right price and
service levels.

[For Captive/Contracted fleets][92] [For Outsourced fleet][93]

#### Hyperlocal Delivery

Be your customers’ leading choice of retailer with same-day or on-demand fulfillment for their
essential needs.

[Know more][94] [Delivery Linked Checkout][95]

#### Returns Scheduling

Keep costs in check and maintain a high benchmark for customer experience by streamlining returns
initiation by customers and collection by the fleet.

[Know More][96] [Watch Webinar][97]

#### End customer

Power superior customer experiences with end-to-end visibility, seamless communication, and by
offering flexible, convenient, and predictable fulfillment options.

[Know more][98] [Convenient fulfillment options][99]

#### Warehouse

Scale up efficiency between four walls to reduce time under the roof for vehicles and improve
service levels.

[Know more][100] [Optimal Warehouse Operations][101]

#### Store

From store replenishment to doorstep deliveries, optimize fulfillment processes to elevate the
customer experience.

[Know more][102] [Omnichannel fulfillment][103]

#### Manufacturer

Optimize both FTL and LTL fulfillment from warehouses with optimal line haul route planning
stretching multiple days.

[Know more][104] [Optimize fulfillment][105]

#### Supplier

Ensure optimal inventory levels and stock replenishment across multiple distribution facilities to
meet demand fluctuations with optimal vehicle loading, route planning, and real-time visiblity.

[Know more][106] [Optimize fulfillment][107]

#### Distributor/Last-mile

Whether you are fulfilling to individual customers or other retailers, elevate last-mile third-party
carrier fulfillment to improve costs, reduce inefficiencies, and power memorable customer
experiences.

[Know More][108] [ShipFlex][109]

### Dispatch Planning

[Dispatch Planning Screenshot]

Automate for All-Mile Logistics Excellence

Our [Dispatch Planning Solutions][110] ensure high OTIF rates and reduce delivery reattempts with
powerful algorithms that optimize routes across 180+ variables, including time, distance, and fuel
efficiency.

Optimize daily scheduling for pickups, deliveries, cancellations, and returns to maximize resource
utilization and enhance delivery performance.

### Hub Operations

[Hub Operations Screenshot]

Achieve Greater Efficiency with Faster Shipment Handling

Locus [Hub Operations][111] reduces shipment handling time in warehouses, distribution, and
fulfillment centers by minimizing manual labor.

Leverage automation for smart sorting, efficient scanning, picklisting, and more to save time and
boost productivity.

### Orchestration

[Orchestration Screenshot]

Seamlessly Scale Capacity

Locus [Delivery Orchestration solutions][112] help you scale your reach, enable asset-light
fulfillment, and manage peak-season demand by automating carrier selection for the best price,
service levels, and efficiency.

Streamline long-haul contracts with real-time automation for invoice calculation, reconciliation,
and payments, tailored to transporter-specific contract parameters.

### Customer Experience

[Customer Experience Screenshot]

Make Every Delivery Memorable

Our [Fulfillment Automation solutions][113] reduce cart abandonment and boost NPS scores by giving
customers control over delivery timing, location, and preferences.

Enhance order fulfillment efficiency while monetizing a variety of shipping options, including
priority, overnight, curbside pickup, and out-of-home (OOH) deliveries.

Ensure consistent fulfillment with adaptable scheduling to manage demand fluctuations and resource
availability.

Our AI-powered logistics platform enables captive, contracted, outsourced, and hybrid fleets to
deliver more while optimizing resources.

Whether you're a Big & Bulky retailer, a leading CPG/FMCG manufacturer, or a multi-brand B2B/B2C
retailer, Locus has solutions tailored for you.

Click the orange icons to discover how Locus delivers results

[Watch our 90-second explainer video][85]

[hero infographics] [hero infographics]

#### Line Haul FTL/PTL

Optimize your fleet’s first-mile or linehaul routes by loading vehicles at full truckloads, or find
new cost efficiencies by hiring freight at less than full or partial truckloads.

[Know more][86] [Volume Utilization][87]

#### Store Replenishment

More and more SKUs are now competing for the same shelf space. Ensure Retail store shelves are
consistently stocked multiple times a day for optimal profitability and operating costs.

[Know more][88] [How to Cut Down on Retail Delivery Costs][89]

#### Multiple Hops Last Mile

Optimize your captive or contracted fleet’s productivity or leverage a vast network of reliable
transporters to add multiple hops within a route.

[Know more][90] [Omnichannel playbook][91]

Enable robust last-mile fulfillment across captive or contracted fleets at optimal costs and
operational efficiency. Alternatively, outsource them to the right carrier at the right price and
service levels.

essential needs.

[Know more][102] [Omnichannel fulfillment][103]

# Get matched with the right ESG, compliance & marketing solutions

#### Simplify your choice of suitable service providers with Matchilla’s unique combination of
#### technology and a personalized approach.

#### And the best part? It’s free and non-binding

[ Register and make a match request ][18]
[Matchilla Funnel.gif]

## How the matching process works:

[Matchilla_step1_1000x1000px]

#### Step 1: Scope

Clear requirements lead to better matches! As such, we will collect the relevant requirements from
you so we can start identifying suitable partners.
[Matchilla_step2_1000x1000px]

#### Step 2: Find

Your anonymized match request will be compared against our database and the relevant providers will
be invited to submit an offer.
[Matchilla_step3_1000x1000px]

#### Step 3: Match

The curated offers end up in your matchboard, where you can easily compare providers and start
negotiating before you pick your match.

# Track Vehicles & Assets With No Monthly Fees

Track fleets, vehicles, trailers, and equipment in real time with alerts, route history, and zero
monthly cost.

Trusted by 1,000+ Businesses Worldwide

Privacy Notice: We don't sell or share any data with any third parties which includes insurance
companies or advertisers.

No activations fees
No monthly fees
No renewal fees

## What Our Customers Say

### **Amazing product & superior support**

Very impressed with Moto Watchdog - both the product and the support. It was quite simple to install
and set up, works flawlessly, provides outstanding tracking and it gives notifications in a timely
and accurate manner. It is also easily customizable for individual needs, particularly the
geofencing and vehicle status alerts...

### **Great value and product works great**

Fantastic product. Works great. Least expensive way to track your fleet that I could find. Solid
reporting. Well worth the price. Finally a company that makes a good solid product that works but
doesn't try to charge to much for it. No subscription is the best part...

### **Fantastic!**

Super easy to set up, just plug to the OBD port in the car, and that's it. You can even open the
box, plug the device to the car, and leave. Then everything else is done in the app which is quite
easy to do and once the car is used, it will get the signal in a few minutes. I bought two; the
first one needed a short drive to get the signal, which is normal, and the second one got it as soon
as I plugged it...

## Connectivity on the move

The digital age has commanded a surge of technologies that can be integrated with high-value assets
enabling real-time control, round-the-clock location tracking and monitoring, and even predictive
maintenance. Also, with [manufacturing automation][102], tasks that were previously manual are now
automated, freeing up workers from repetitive, time-intensive processes, making our production
processes more efficient.

[Read More][103]
[ [Human Machine Interface image] ][104]

## Creating a more intuitive user experience

Devices these days are designed to provide the best user experience. This can be achieved through an
effective Human Machine Interface (HMI) that is efficient and intuitive, and improves the way we
interact with our devices and the way we live.

[Read More][105]
[ [Single Board Computer image] ][106]

## Customized product designs and faster time-to-market

The increase of Internet of Things (IoT) technology adoption and the challenge of improving product
time-to-market has prompted an adaptation of product design incorporating Single Board Computer
(SBC). Our High-Mix Low-Volume (HMLV) Manufacturing strategies allows us to offer a range of
high-quality products in smaller quantities.

[Read More][107]

## To the cloud and beyond

Changing manufacturing in profound ways, the advent of cloud computing or Internet of Things (IoT)
has brought about affordable sensors, and extensive interconnectivity of connected machines and
devices.

[Read More][109]

## Fiduciary Duty & Leadership Accountability

**How Proof Helps CEOs, CFOs, CMOs, CROs, and CDOs Meet Fiduciary Standards**

##### For CEOs:

##### Managing Enterprise-Wide Risk & Strategic Certainty
* The **2023 Delaware ruling** increases your **fiduciary duty** to make **data-backed strategic
  decisions**. Proof provides **Causal AI insights** that help you **quantify risk**,
  **opportunity**, and **performance trade-offs**—ensuring defensible leadership decisions.
* **Align strategy with accountability**—use Proof’s actuarial-grade forecasting to justify budget
  allocations and investment priorities with confidence.
* **Reduce reliance on gut-driven decision-making**—replace intuition with causal, evidence-based
  insights that prove what’s working and what isn’t.

##### **For CFOs:**

Strengthening Financial Stewardship & Budget Risk Management
* **Fiduciary risk has never been higher**—ensure financial decisions are backed by Causal AI-driven
  risk-adjusted forecasting, making budgeting and resource allocation an underwriting process, not a
  guessing game.
* **Tie investments to outcomes**—with Proof, you can audit every dollar spent, ensuring spend
  efficiency and reducing financial leakage from underperforming initiatives.
* **Optimize cost structure**—reduce functional spend on analytics and consulting by leveraging
  Proof’s automated rolling recalculations instead of expensive, one-time manual audits.

##### For CMOs:

##### Defending Budgets & Meeting Fiduciary Obligations
* Marketing budgets must now be justified under stricter fiduciary scrutiny—Proof provides clear,
  causal evidence of which campaigns drive true business impact and which don’t.
* Eliminate risk in budget approvals—defend marketing investments with rigorous, AI-backed ROI
  calculations that withstand financial oversight.
* Protect marketing’s strategic influence—ensure budget decisions are tied to provable revenue
  contributions, keeping marketing a boardroom priority.

##### **For CROs:**

Proving Sales & Revenue Efficiency
* Sales leaders must now demonstrate financial accountability—Proof isolates revenue-driving
  activities so CROs can show which strategies and investments truly generate pipeline and growth.
* Strengthen fiduciary compliance in forecasting—rolling recalculations ensure forecasts remain
  accurate and aligned with real-time revenue performance.
* Validate GTM investments—ensure that sales enablement tools, territories, and segments deliver
  verifiable ROI, minimizing waste and risk exposure.

##### For CDOs:

##### Ensuring Data Integrity & Analytical Accuracy
* The 2023 Delaware ruling raises the stakes for data governance—Proof helps ensure models,
  forecasts, and analytics are accurate, defensible, and auditable.
* Eliminate noise and correlation bias—Proof isolates true cause-and-effect relationships, ensuring
  leadership is acting on reliable, bias-free insights.
* Automate continuous improvement—rolling recalculations ensure models self-correct in real-time,
  keeping strategy aligned with reality.

# Leaders of the Telematics Revolution

Dedicated to transforming fleet management with creative, customised solutions.

[REQUEST INFORMATION][21]

UK Telematics is a Global Online Positioning Platform that delivers valuable and customisable
information, enabling organisations the efficient and secure management of their mobile resources.
UK Telematics is a unique, industry approved system providing a fully comprehensive, flexible and
highly cost effective vehicle and asset tracking solution. It is convenient to use, needing only
Internet access to take full advantage of the significant benefits of UK Telematics.

# UK TELEMATICS IS A FULL SERVICE PROVIDER

[image]

#### ALL SERVICES IN HOUSE

As industry experts, UK Telematics can support and advise you throughout the entire telematics
journey. UK Telematics provides a full 360 service, designing developing and installing our own
solutions with UK based customer support and training.

#### CHOOSING THE RIGHT SERVICE

Our telematics systems are not off-the-shelf packages, but are tailor made. Each customer is treated
as an individual, and systems can be created and customised to suit specific needs and unique
requirements.

#### SALES SUPPORT

UK Telematics’ team will guide you through the introduction of telematics to your employees. Support
and assistance with end user buy in is available. Our telematics solutions have been developed
taking all stakeholders into account, from fleet managers to vehicle operators and trade unions.

#### CUSTOMER TEAM TRAINING

UK Telematics can send a dedicated training team to customers own premises to train system
administrators. UK Telematics are there for you, providing ongoing support throughout the lifetime
of the contract.

## WHY UK TELEMATICS
* Full fleet compliance
* Improved worker safety solutions
* Improved fleet management and utilisation of resources
* Reduced fleet costs- fuel, maintenance, depreciation and insurance
* Knowledge of location of vehicles and assets, real time and historical
* Comparison of timesheets with actual driving hours
* No installation of extra software onto a PC or network
* Low capital and network administration costs
* Accessible from any Internet device
* Expertise in telematic technology

[REQUEST MORE INFORMATION][22]

## FIND YOUR SOLUTION


UK Telematics provides a comprehensive solution to your biggest challenges, no matter what industry
you operate in. Discover more about each solution below :

## PARTNERS


## LEARN MORE ABOUT UK TELEMATICS SOLUTIONS

[Enquire Now][23]

UK Telematics has successfully provided Northern Powergrid (NPG) with vehicle telematics to their
fleet of 800 utilities industry vehicles. Overall data analysis demonstrates that improved driver
behaviour and tangible savings are a positive result of the installation and effective management of
a UK Telematics system.

NORTH EAST UTILITIES DISTRIBUTOR
TELEMATICS CUSTOMER

UK Telematics were the only supplier able to assist Wales and West Utilities with integration of
their existing systems and the vehicle tracking system. By re-configuring the Vehicle Tracking Units
firmware and installing in-cab cabling between the telematics hardware and the in-cab Toughbook’s,
UK Telematics were able to provide a fully joined up and integrated service for the client.

WALES AND WEST UTILITIES
TELEMATICS CUSTOMER

# Prove Marketing ROI.
# Ignite Growth. Unleash AI.

CMOs are under brutal pressure to do more with less and outpace the market. But when your data lives
in silos, spreadsheets, and disconnected tools, it’s impossible. AI on broken data doesn’t fix
anything — it supercharges the chaos. It’s time to break free with Decision Intelligence.

[ Book a demo ][67]

### Trusted by the world’s biggest brands

## Unite these 4 data streams and unlock real ROI.

When you connect plans, budgets, spend, and performance in one powerful platform, magic happens. You
make lightning-fast decisions. You align every investment to real outcomes. You finally earn the
financial credibility to defend — and grow — your budget with total confidence. No more forensic
accounting. No more wasting half your budget proving you spent the other half wisely.

## Uptempo turns connected data into unstoppable optimization.

Optimization isn’t a quarterly event — it’s a living, breathing feedback loop that gets smarter
every cycle. Uptempo closes the loop by unifying your four data streams into one intelligent,
marketing-native model.

Signal Detection

AI reveals hidden patterns and breakthrough insights across channels and time that no human could
catch alone.

Scenario Modeling

Test dozens of bold reallocation scenarios before moving a single dollar.

In-Flight Optimization

Catch underperformers in real time and pivot while the opportunity is still alive.

Being able to tie the spend to the audiences and the performance
for every activity is huge. It’s something we’ve never been able to do.

Paul Ambraz, Vice President of Marketing Communications, IBM

## The marketer
## with the most
## connected
## data wins.

*Not* the one with the most tools. *Not* the one with the flashiest AI. The winner has a rock-solid
data foundation that supercharges their team — and their AI. This is Decision Intelligence: your new
strategic thought partner. It speaks your language. It turns data into clear signals, confident
forecasts, and actionable guidance. Stop reporting what happened. Start deciding what’s next.

One Source of Truth

A single, unbreakable view of budget, plan, spend, and performance — trusted by Marketing, Finance,
and the Board.

Faster Decisions

Ditch the reconciliation drudgery. Spend your time on high-impact moves. In-flight optimization
replaces painful post-mortems.

Continuous Loop

Every cycle makes the next one stronger. Your model sharpens. Your ROI case becomes bulletproof.

Contextual ROI

Prove exactly what’s working — down to campaign, persona, market, or channel. Ruthlessly cut losers.
Aggressively double down on winners.
